Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

5078-6766-7730-8171.description:

728-801-3249-6006.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-801-3249-6006.description:

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

553-1542-2093.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Wizards of Thay.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

215-527-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-7730.description:

When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

783-1399-1606-7223.description:

1170-1329-1414-2846.description:

2104-5626-6927.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}
2104-5626-6927.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Damage Control Crew, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

972-2493-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2493-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying its mana cost.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer and the Great Whale token.
When the Archaeomancer and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2493-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Archaeomancer instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

4871-6074-6753.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2060-3705-5256-6701.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying its mana cost.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Squee.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
2060-3705-5256-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

Each opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to sacrifice Bronze Bombshell.
2378-4859-6550.description:
Cast Mirrorweave by paying {2}{W/U}{W/U}, causing each other creature to become a copy of It That Betrays until end of turn.
Sacrifice Bronze Bombshell by any method, triggering each It That Betrays controlled by an opponent.
Resolve one of the It the Betrays triggers, causing an opponent to put Bronze Bombshell from your graveyard onto the battlefield under their control.
Bronze Bombshell triggers, causing its controller to sacrifice it and dealing 7 damage to its controller.
Each It That Betrays not controlled by Bronze Bombshell's controller triggers, with your triggers being below each opponent's triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
2378-4859-6550.notes: The combo will work until there is exactly one opponent remaining. Depending on opposing life totals, this may or may not result in all opponents losing the game, or in one opponent surviving.

Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 3, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
